issues_in: Duplicate non-canonical GPB URL for the same article: actions[3].primary_url and contradictions[3].source_urls use 'https://www.gpb.org/news/2025/09/19/rural-twiggs-county-approves (NOTE: the issue string itself is truncated mid-URL in inventory.json; substance = same GPB article referenced via two different URL slugs, one non-canonical)
fixed: Verified the two GPB URL slugs for the 2025-09-19 article 'Rural Twiggs County approves rezoning for a data center with a city-sized appetite for power': slug variant '...-approves-rezoning-for-a-data-center-...' returns HTTP 404 via web fetch (curl HEAD/GET to gpb.org is blocked with HTTP 403 by WAF/bot protection); canonical slug '...-approves-rezoning-for-data-center-...' returns HTTP 200 with the article content.

data.json: replaced actions[3].primary_url (2025-09-19 reported-rezoning action) from the 404 non-canonical GPB slug to the canonical working GPB slug, so it now matches sources.refresh_2026_08_11 and the contradictions capacity_mw source_urls (single working URL for the article).

data.json: appended a history entry (date 2026-08-11, field actions[3].primary_url) recording the old URL value and the reason for the swap, keeping the superseded URL in the record rather than deleting it.
NOTES.md: added a dated fix-pass bullet under the 2026-08-11 section documenting the URL dedupe/normalization with both the dead and canonical URLs.
remaining_risks: Direct curl HEAD/GET to gpb.org returns HTTP 403 (WAF/bot protection) for both slugs; the 404-vs-200 determination was made via the web fetch engine (different client). A human-browser recheck is advisable but the canonical slug is confirmed live with matching article content.

The inventory issue text is truncated mid-URL, so its exact quoted URL cannot be compared character-for-character; the substance (duplicate non-canonical GPB URL for one article) was fully addressed and no non-canonical slug remains in active use.

The issue cites 'contradictions[3]' but data.json's contradictions array has 3 entries (indices 0-2); the GPB URL lives in the capacity_mw contradiction (index 2), which already used the canonical slug, so no edit was needed there. If the reviewer's numbering implied a 4th contradictions entry, none exists in the current data.
No other issue types applied to this center; SKILL.md was not modified (no schema drift flagged for this center).
